fn: Team Schedule: supervisors can swap two shifts while editing (Swap shifts button).
ds: Team Schedule editor (Geologist and Core Checkers): new Swap shifts button. Click it, then click the two slots; the two people exchange places (same day or different days, same rig or different rigs). Choosing an empty slot moves the person there. Shows a heads-up if the swap leaves someone double-booked or with short rest. Supports Undo and Revert all. Same change in the standalone Team Schedule app (v215).
